title: Recover original bridge listener ownership and profile-start registration cleanup

scope.claim: Pins the original host-global shared listener owner, ordinary profile_instance_start launch future, startup registration before LaunchEnvelope handoff, 90-second pending refresh during launch progression, and explicit unregister cleanup on post-registration launch cleanup paths.

listenerOwnership.meaning: The application startup path constructs the recovered bridge host. R7-098/R7-100 established that this host constructor derives the per-user pipe identity and starts the shared asynchronous accept loop, so listener ownership is host-global rather than per profile launch.

ordering.conclusion: The startup registration is established before the later recovered LaunchEnvelope handoff into the profile-launch task.
ordering.asyncCaveat: The profile launch function is an async state-machine poll, so raw address ordering alone was not used as proof; the recovered branch/state flow and nested futures were inspected.

pendingRegistrationRefresh.meaning: While startup progresses, the same pending registration receives a new current-clock-plus-90-second deadline.

expiryCorrection.finding: Registration deadline expiry rejects a first handshake but does not delete the retained pending registration.
expiryCorrection.consequence: An expired unclaimed instance key still rejects duplicate Register until explicit Unregister releases it.
expiryCorrection.test: OverviewBridgeRegistryChecks now pins expired-retention, duplicate-after-expiry, and explicit-unregister release behavior.
expiryCorrection.supersedesInference: Do not model failed pre-handshake launch cleanup as passive expiry.

launchFailureCleanup.meaning: Post-registration launch cleanup explicitly unregisters the instance instead of relying on deadline expiry.

separateReconcilePath.boundary: This call is not used as evidence for ordinary profile_instance_start cleanup.

remainingBlocker: Implement source-backed host-owned listener lifetime and real outbound RPC transport, then recover pending-call add/correlate/timeout/shutdown ownership before enabling the narrow call_lua(getStatus) path or exposing non-null get_status.pending.
